title: CS Exit Survey
description: Tell the department how well your coursework prepared you. Your answers are anonymous.
needs: Nothing to look up. It takes about five minutes.

intro.title: This survey is anonymous
body: Your answers are not linked to your name, W# or email. Faculty see the answers, but not who wrote them.
Please be honest, and please keep it constructive. Feedback that is aggressive or uses profanity is hard to act on, and the faculty reading it are people too.

pages.title: How prepared were you?
pages.description: Answer based on how your coursework prepared you, not on the internship itself.
